note: A voice_id is an identifier, not a secret, so it is committed. The API key never is: it lives in packages/web/.env.local, which .gitignore covers.
modelNote: multilingual_v2 at Blake's direction. Note its alignment is NOT one timestamp per displayed character (22 for a 20-character line) because it aligns against normalised text; displayCharsSpokenBy scales by fraction so the typewriter stays in sync under either model.
settingsNote: v2 reads stability as a continuous value, unlike v3's three discrete modes, so 0.45 is meaningful here — slightly looser than neutral, which suits a narrator over a reader.
